core_obligations: Replace $S$ by $\Spec(\mathcal{O}_{S,s})$ so that the base becomes local Noetherian, the property being local at $s$ (proof lines 4937-4938).
Invoke the impurity lemma over a Noetherian base together with characterization (2) of purity to compare the local condition with the universal one (proof lines 4938-4941).
Conclude the equivalence of purity and universal purity along the fibre $X_s$ (proof lines 4927-4933).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to a Noetherian local base (proof lines 4937-4938).
Impurity lemma and characterization (2) of purity (proof lines 4938-4941).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that when the local ring of the base at a point is Noetherian, purity of a finite type module along the fibre is equivalent to universal purity along that fibre (statement lines 4927-4934). The proof localizes the base at the point, so that the Noetherian impurity lemma applies, and translates between purity and the absence of impurities using characterization (2) of purity. The reduction and the translation are the substance, so the claim is H2.
